_comment: ARC Azure DEV parameters. Contains NO secrets. Entra admin identity is supplied on the command line at deploy time.
_policyNotes: Subscription npedureka-1709415296501 assigns policy Edureka_AZ / Edureka_AZ_AllowOnlyCoreServices (effect: deny).
Microsoft.ServiceBus/namespaces is absent from the allow-list, so deployServiceBus must be false here.
Microsoft.Web/serverFarms is restricted to B1/B2/S1, so the Functions host uses a B1 plan instead of Y1 consumption.
Allowed locations: eastus, eastus2, centralus, Sweden Central, westus2, global.
